rows.grounds: ablative sense of source; fused form as given
ellipsis marker indicating missing or omitted text
instrumental plural indicating means or materials
compound or juxtaposed form indicating the body in question

items.question: With what substances and how constantly should that body be filled?
premises: Milk is indicated as a source material.
Fillings or additional substances serve as means.
The prescribed action is to fill that body continually.
items.inference: One should always fill that body using milk and other fillings as the means.
uncertainties: The ellipsis marker obscures additional substances or instructions.
The exact internal formation of kṣīrādā is unclear in the fused form.
items.plain_english: One should always fill that body with milk and with other fillings.
